quote: GPT-5.6 Sol was released on July 9, 2026 with Sol Ultra as a high-effort reasoning tier variant.
kind_note: reasoning tier of GPT-5.6 Sol base model
note: Sol Ultra is a high-effort reasoning mode of GPT-5.6 Sol with enhanced performance on agentic coding tasks. Limited preview began June 26, 2026; general availability July 9, 2026. Sol Ultra uses the same pricing as base Sol ($5.00 per million input tokens, $30.00 per million output tokens).
queries: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra OpenAI release date 2026
